title: BoltBeam Time Budget
description: Where one request's wall time went, from a GPU trace (collectors/time_budget.py): wall = kernels (union) + exposed copy + idle + host time outside the GPU window. Each part is measured on its own; unattributed_ms is wall less their sum, never forced to zero.

engine.description: the key of the engine's rows in data/kernel_families.json, or the keys in order (a fork, then its root)

vendor.description: the GPU vendor key (target/vendors.py) of the vendor rows

wall_ms.description: the client's wall time for the request; null: not known

window_ms.description: first GPU operation to the last in the span

kernels_ms.description: the union of the kernels' spans

exposed_copy_ms.description: copy time with no kernel running

idle_ms.description: the sum of the window's gaps with no kernel and no copy in flight

host_outside_ms.description: wall less the window, at least 0; null without a wall, and null (unknown) when the window is longer than the wall

unattributed_ms.description: wall (or the window, without a wall) less the parts

host_how.description: host time is the wall less the window: a residual, so with a wall the parts meet it by construction

window_fits_wall.description: the GPU window is no longer than the wall (within tolerance): the check the sum cannot make

engine_rows_missing.description: engine keys with no rows in data/kernel_families.json

decode.description: a decode request (collectors/time_budget.decode_budget): the forwards told main or draft by the engine's own counts (refused, with the counts, when no cut gives them), one step per verify forward, what bounds a token, the capture overhead

check.description: the engine's counts (its decode row and the request's spec-decode counters) against the forwards the trace holds

input_copy.description: the forward rule's input copies by what they carry: an input table the engine keeps in host RAM (each copy a whole number of its rows, with the GPU idle right before it: the host gathering) or unidentified (no host_before_ms)

bound.description: the step's weight bytes (roofline/forward_read.py) at the GPU's measured read rate, against the step's wall

capture_overhead.description: the profiler's measured overhead: every prompt at this k and depth, traced against untraced (replay_overhead.overhead_words), or why it is not measured
